description.zh: 应用名称。仅允许使用数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_） ，而且必须以英文字母开头，最长36个字符。
description.en: The name of the application. The name can contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter and can be up to 36 characters in length.

description.zh:
EDAS-Container构建包号，当创建HSF应用时，该参数必须指定。有以下两种获取方式：

- 通过容器版本列表接口ListBuildPack获取，请参见[ListBuildPack](~~149391~~)。

- 在参见[容器版本](~~92614~~)表格中的**构建包序号**列获取。
description.en:
The build package number of EDAS-Container. This parameter is required when you create a High-speed Service Framework (HSF) application. You can obtain the build package number in one of the following ways:

- Call the ListBuildPack operation. For more information, see [ListBuildPack](~~149391~~).

- Obtain the build package number from the **Build Package Number** column in the [Container versions](~~92614~~) table.

description.zh: ECS集群ID。ECS集群ID不为空，则为指定的ECS集群创建应用，为空则为默认集群创建应用（推荐指定）。
description.en: The ID of the ECS cluster. Specify this parameter to create the application in a specific ECS cluster. If you leave this parameter empty, the application is created in the default cluster. We recommend that you specify this parameter.

description.zh:
应用组件ID。可通过查询组件列表接口ListComponents接口获取，请参见[ListComponents](~~97502~~)。

当创建的应用运行环境使用Apache Tomcat（适用于WAR包部署的Dubbo应用）或者标准Java应用运行环境（适用于JAR包部署的Spring Boot或Spring Cloud应用）时需要指定。

常用的应用组件ID及含义：

- 4：Apache Tomcat 7.0.91
- 7：Apache Tomcat 8.5.42
- 5：表示OpenJDK 1.8.x
- 6：表示 OpenJDK 1.7.x

该参数需要更新Java或者Python SDK版本到2.57.3或以上版本才可以设置，未使用EDAS提供的SDK的（例如在使用aliyun-python-sdk-core、aliyun-java-sdk-core、aliyun cli等）用户可直接设置该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the application component. You can call the ListComponents operation to query the component ID. For more information, see [ListComponents](~~97502~~).

This parameter is required if the application runs in an Apache Tomcat container (for Dubbo applications that are deployed in a WAR package) or a standard Java application runtime environment (for Spring Boot or Spring Cloud applications that are deployed in a JAR package).

The following application component IDs are commonly used:

- 4: Apache Tomcat 7.0.91

- 7: Apache Tomcat 8.5.42

- 5: OpenJDK 1.8.x

- 6: OpenJDK 1.7.x

To set this parameter, you must update the Java or Python software development kit (SDK) to version 2.57.3 or later. If you do not use an EDAS SDK, such as aliyun-python-sdk-core, aliyun-java-sdk-core, or Alibaba Cloud CLI, you can set this parameter.

description.zh: **（废弃参数）**Swarm集群应用容器CPU核数。
description.en: \*\*(Deprecated)\*\* The number of CPU cores for the application container in a Swarm cluster.

description.zh: 应用描述信息。
description.en: The description of the application.

description.zh: 需要扩容的ECS实例的`ecu_id`（导入EDAS的ECS实例在EDAS中的唯一身份），多个`ecu_id`用英文逗号（,）分开。`ecu_id`可通过查询ListScaleOutEcu接口获取，请参见[ListScaleOutEcu](~~149371~~)。
description.en: The \`ecu\_id\` of the ECS instance to which you want to scale out the application. The \`ecu\_id\` is the unique ID of an ECS instance that is imported to EDAS. To specify multiple \`ecu\_id\`s, separate them with commas (,). You can call the ListScaleOutEcu operation to query the \`ecu\_id\`. For more information, see [ListScaleOutEcu](~~149371~~).

description.zh:
是否启用端口健康检查，取值如下：

- **true**：启用

- **false**：不启用
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the port health check. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled

- **false**: Disabled

description.zh:
是否启用健康检查URL，取值如下：

- **true**：启用

- **false**：不启用
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the health check URL. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled

- **false**: Disabled

description.zh: 应用健康检查URL（等价于HealthCheckURL参数）。
description.en: The health check URL of the application. This parameter is equivalent to the HealthCheckURL parameter.

description.zh:
挂载脚本配置，为一段JSON格式文本，如：
`[{"ignoreFail":false,"name":"postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut","script":"ls"},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"postdeleteInstanceDataOnScaleIn","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestopInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststopInstance","script":""}]`
description.en:
The configuration of the mounted script. The value is a JSON string. Example:
`[{"ignoreFail":false,"name":"postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut","script":"ls"},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"postdeleteInstanceDataOnScaleIn","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststartInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"prestopInstance","script":""},{"ignoreFail":true,"name":"poststopInstance","script":""}]`

description.zh: **（废弃参数）**  用来指定应用使用的JDK版本。
description.en: **(Deprecated)** The version of the Java Development Kit (JDK) that the application uses.

description.zh: 自定义参数。
description.en: The custom parameters.

description.zh:
微服务空间ID，您可在EDAS控制台左侧菜单栏选择**资源管理** > **微服务空间**，找到目标微服务空间对应的微服务空间ID，也可通过ListUserDefineRegion接口获取到微服务空间ID，请参见[ListUserDefineRegion](~~149377~~)。
 
- 如果指定的集群不在默认微服务空间下，则需要指定该参数，否则会遇到`application regionId is different with cluster regionId!`的错误提示。
- 如果在默认微服务空间下，则不需要指定。该参数需要与指定的集群ID所在的微服务空间保持一致。
description.en:
The ID of the microservices namespace. In the EDAS console, choose **Resource Management** > **Microservices Namespace** in the navigation pane on the left to view the ID of the microservices namespace. You can also call the ListUserDefineRegion operation to query the ID. For more information, see [ListUserDefineRegion](~~149377~~).

- If the specified cluster is not in the default microservices namespace, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the \`application regionId is different with cluster regionId!\` error is reported.

- If the cluster is in the default microservices namespace, you do not need to specify this parameter. The microservices namespace of the application must be the same as the microservices namespace of the specified cluster.

description.zh: 最大堆内存大小，单位M。
description.en: The maximum size of the heap memory. Unit: MB.

description.zh: 持久代内存大小，单位M。
description.en: The size of the permanent generation memory. Unit: MB.

description.zh: **（废弃参数）**Swarm集群应用容器Memory大小。
description.en: \*\*(Deprecated)\*\* The memory size for the application container in a Swarm cluster.

description.zh: 初始化堆内存大小，单位M。
description.en: The initial size of the heap memory. Unit: MB.

description.zh: 应用部署包格式，可设置为war或者jar。
description.en: The format of the application deployment package. Valid values: war and jar.

description.zh: **（废弃参数）**应用预留端口号。
description.en: \*\*(Deprecated)\*\* The reserved port of the application.

description.zh: 资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: **（废弃参数）** 用于指定Apache Tomcat版本。
description.en: **(Deprecated)** The version of Apache Tomcat.

title.zh: 创建 ECS 集群的应用

descriptions.zh: >  如需要创建K8s集群应用，则需要使用EDAS提供的InsertK8sApplication接口。
descriptions.en: > To create an application in a Kubernetes cluster, call the InsertK8sApplication operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas insert-application --cluster-id 13136119-f384-4f50-b76e-xxxxxxxxxxx --build-pack-id 59 --description create_by_edas_pop_api --application-name hello-edas-test-1 --reserved-port-str 8090 --ecu-info 07bd417a-b863-477d-0000-000000000000 --cpu 2 --mem 2048 --logical-region-id cn-beijing:prod --jdk 8 --web-container 4 --package-type war --component-ids 7 --hooks ignoreFail_:false,_name_:_postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut_,_script_:_ls --jvm-options -Dproperty=value --min-heap-size 500 --max-perm-size 200 --max-heap-size 1000 --enable-url-check true --enable-port-check true --health-check-url http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html --resource-group-id rg-aek24j4s4b00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas POST /pop/v5/changeorder/co_create_app --region cn-hangzhou --MaxPermSize 200 --LogicalRegionId 'cn-beijing:prod' --MaxHeapSize 1000 --Description create_by_edas_pop_api --ApplicationName 'hello-edas-test-1' --HealthCheckUrl 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek24j4s4b00000' --ClusterId '13136119-f384-4f50-b76e-xxxxxxxxxxx' --WebContainer 4 --Cpu 2 --BuildPackId 59 --MinHeapSize 500 --EnablePortCheck true --Jdk 8 --ComponentIds 7 --ReservedPortStr 8090 --EcuInfo '07bd417a-b863-477d-0000-000000000000' --Mem 2048 --PackageType war --JvmOptions '-Dproperty=value' --Hooks 'ignoreFail_:false,_name_:_postprepareInstanceEnvironmentOnScaleOut_,_script_:_ls' --EnableUrlCheck true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
